# Structured Rd fixtures

The return entries and equations in `rd_content.Rd` come from `euler.Rd`, and
its table comes from `plot.euler.Rd`, in
[eulerr commit 8030deb](https://github.com/jolars/eulerr/tree/8030deb7e6945af178b5717701389da12e036d5a/man).
Those excerpts retain their original markup and are covered by the included MIT
license. The topic name, usage, link examples, and conditional prose are synthetic.
Tests copy this fixture into temporary workspaces.
